mentions.name: MonteGrid
mentions.description: A Monte Carlo simulation Excel plugin that runs on Mac, built in JavaScript with Rust compiled to WASM for the scientific computing core.
mentions.source_excerpt: https://asunder.co/montegrid - Mainly working on a Monte Carlo Excel plugin that can run on Mac. Standard scientific computing shenanigans ... one benefit of everything being Javascript is that one can use Rust -> WASM everywhere :)
